entries.source:
使用只允许编辑此仓库的 GitHub Fine-grained Personal Access Token 登录。
        令牌仅保存在当前浏览器会话中，不会写入网页或 GitHub 仓库。
entries.translation:
Log in using a GitHub Fine-grained Personal Access Token that only allows editing of this repository.
        The token is only stored in the current browser session and is not written to the web page or GitHub repository.

entries.source: 需要该仓库的 Contents 读写权限。请勿使用账号密码，也不要授予无关仓库的权限。
entries.translation: Read and write access to the Contents of this repository is required. Do not use your account password, and do not grant permissions to unrelated repositories.
Import old content from this device

entries.source: 支持 JPG、PNG、GIF、HEIC 等图片格式
entries.translation: Supports image formats such as JPG, PNG, GIF, HEIC, etc.

entries.source:
输入只读查看口令后，才会显示隐藏内容栏目。
        第一次设置时，管理员输入的文本将作为加密密钥，因此请妥善保管。
entries.translation:
The hidden content section will only be displayed after entering the read-only view password.
        When setting up for the first time, the text entered by the administrator will be used as the encryption key, so please keep it safe.

entries.source:
设置访客查看隐藏内容时使用的口令。口令不会明文写入 GitHub；
        内容文件会使用由此口令派生的 AES 密钥加密。
entries.translation:
Set the password used by guests to view hidden content. The password will not be written to GitHub in plain text;
        Content files will be encrypted using an AES key derived from this password.

entries.source: 修改口令时将由管理员模式自动完成重新加密，无需再次输入旧口令。
entries.translation: When changing the password, re-encryption will be automatically performed in administrator mode, and there is no need to enter the old password again.

entries.source: 删除后将同步更新 GitHub 中的留言数据，此操作不可撤销。
entries.translation: After deletion, the comment data in GitHub will be updated synchronously. This operation cannot be undone.
